matchmaking_summary: E. April Bradford is a forward-thinking professional with a diverse background in human resources, sales, customer service, and education. With excellent communication and computer skills, high organizational skills, and meticulous attention to detail, she has demonstrated strong leadership abilities through managing HR contact center operations and taking initiative in training new hires and supporting colleagues. Her educational achievements at Strayer University and Fayetteville State University, along with her memberships in professional organizations like GSHRM and SHRM, indicate a commitment to ongoing learning and engagement within the industry.
